description_en: Retrieves accelerated domain names based on certificate information
description_zh: 根据证书信息获取加速域名
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-domain-by-certificate --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ssl-pub 000000 --ssl-status true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveDomainByCertificate

parameters.help_en: The public key of the certificate. The public key must be Base64 encoding and then URL-encoded (encodeURIComponent). The PEM format is supported
parameters.help_zh: 证书公钥，需要base64编码后再进行encodeURIComponent。支持pem格式
parameters.name: ssl_pub

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the returned domain name list includes only domain names with HTTPS enabled or disabled.
true: HTTPS is enabled.
false: HTTPS is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
表示返回的域名列表只包含开启或关闭HTTPS的域名。
true：开启。
false：关闭
parameters.name: ssl_status

CertCaIsLegacy.description_en:
The legacy status of the certificate CA. Valid values:
yes: The certificate CA is deprecated.
no: The certificate CA is normal and not deprecated
CertCaIsLegacy.description_zh:
证书CA废弃状态。取值：
yes：已废弃。
no：正常，未废弃

CertExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate. The time follows the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format in UTC+8
CertExpireTime.description_zh: 证书过期时间。日期格式按照 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 表示法，并使用 UTC+8（东八区）时间

CertExpired.description_en:
The expiration status of the certificate. Valid values:
yes: The certificate has expired.
no: The certificate has not expired
CertExpired.description_zh:
证书过期状态。 取值：
yes：已过期。
no：未过期

CertStartTime.description_en: The start time of the certificate. The time follows the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format in UTC+8
CertStartTime.description_zh: 证书开始时间。日期格式按照 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 表示法，并使用 UTC+8（东八区）时间

CertSubjectCommonName.description_en: The name of the certificate owner

CertType.description_en: The type of the certificate. Valid values: RSA, DSA, and ECDSA

DomainList.description_en: If this value is not empty, the list is matched against the certificate. Multiple values are separated by commas (,)
DomainList.description_zh: 如果该返回值不为空，则将该列表与证书做匹配，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔

DomainNames.description_en: The domain names that match the certificate (DNS field). Multiple domain names are separated by commas (,)
DomainNames.description_zh: 证书匹配的域名（DNS字段），多个用半角逗号（,）分隔

Issuer.example: C=US, O=Symantec Corporation, OU=Symantec Trust Network, OU=Domain Validated SSL, CN=Symantec Basic DV SSL CA - G1
